verification.note: frontend/src/components/TextThumbnail.tsx:85 calls `raw.trim()` when `isOffice || showsRaw`. In the rows table of frontend/src/components/__tests__/sourceCardExcerptText.test.tsx:129-184, every other + text/* body (rows at lines 133, 139, 145, 151, 157, 163, 169, 175) starts and ends with a non-blank character, and each `expected` is byte-identical to `body`. So mutating line 85 to `showsRaw ? raw : ...` leaves every row passing. TextThumbnail.test.tsx:102-167 only uses `note()` and never draws an other + text/* file, so it does not catch the mutant either. behavior.md:34-35 explicitly requires 'only leading and trailing blank space trimmed', so this is a stated requirement that no test checks.

frontend/src/lib/textExcerpt.ts:17-18 (`mime startsWith text/` and then `document || other`) and textExcerpt.ts:23-26 (`other && mime startsWith text/`) state the other+text/* condition separately, and no shared helper connects them. Surfaces gate on showsTextExcerpt (FileCard.tsx:75, FileListRow.tsx:87, JustifiedFileCell.tsx:63), while TextThumbnail.tsx:71 chooses the transform on its own through showsRawExcerpt, which skips the hasThumbnail check. Today they agree, because TextThumbnail only renders after the gate passes. The claim is a maintainability coupling, not a present wrong result.
